Scenario.c_pkgs: when c_prep client pkgs_client emit c_pkgs
Scenario.c_cfg: when c_pkgs client cfg_client emit c_cfg
Scenario.client_up: when c_cfg client dnsutils_client emit client_up
Scenario.ca_pkgs: when ca_prep cache pkgs_bind emit ca_pkgs
Scenario.cache_up: when ca_pkgs cache cfg_cache emit cache_up
Scenario.au_pkgs: when au_prep auth pkgs_bind emit au_pkgs
Scenario.auth_up: when au_pkgs auth cfg_auth emit auth_up
Scenario.attacker_up: when at_prep attacker pkgs_attacker emit attacker_up
Scenario.verify_dns: when cache_up, auth_up, client_up client dns_check

Bindings.pkgs_client: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install net-tools iptables >/tmp/dew-$nid-pkgs.log 2>&1 && command -v netstat >/dev/null && command -v iptables >/dev/null"
Bindings.cfg_client: bash -c "sudo sed -i '1i nameserver 10.1.2.2' /etc/resolv.conf && sudo iptables -A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 53 -d 172.30.0.1 -j DROP && sudo iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 53 -d 172.30.0.1 -j DROP && grep -q 10.1.2.2 /etc/resolv.conf"
Bindings.dnsutils_client: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install dnsutils >/tmp/dew-$nid-dig.log 2>&1 && command -v dig >/dev/null"
Bindings.pkgs_bind: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install bind9 bind9utils bind9-doc net-tools iptables >/tmp/dew-$nid-pkgs.log 2>&1 && command -v named >/dev/null"
Bindings.cfg_cache: bash -c "sudo sed -i '1i nameserver 10.1.2.3' /etc/resolv.conf && sudo cp /tmp/$nid/named.conf.options.cache /etc/bind/named.conf.options && sudo service named reload && sleep 2 && (systemctl is-active --quiet named || systemctl is-active --quiet bind9)"
Bindings.cfg_auth: bash -c "sudo cp /tmp/$nid/named.conf.local /etc/bind/named.conf.local && sudo cp /tmp/$nid/named.conf.options.auth /etc/bind/named.conf.options && sudo mkdir -p /etc/bind/zones && sudo cp /tmp/$nid/db.google.com /etc/bind/zones/ && sudo cp /tmp/$nid/db.10 /etc/bind/zones/ && sudo service bind9 restart && sleep 2 && (systemctl is-active --quiet named || systemctl is-active --quiet bind9) && test -f /etc/bind/zones/db.google.com"
Bindings.pkgs_attacker: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install ettercap-text-only tshark net-tools iptables docker.io >/tmp/dew-$nid-pkgs.log 2>&1 && command -v ettercap >/dev/null && command -v tshark >/dev/null && command -v docker >/dev/null"
